claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a white LG front-load washer with “LG” and “DirectDrive 7Kg” visible on the control panel (photo 0).

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Witness report notes scuffs/marks and visible rust/oxidation and dirt stains around the lower front edge/door area (photo 0), which may not match “barely used.”

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show operation, diagnostics, or whether the motor was opened; witness only reports exterior condition (photo 0).
Witness report does not show receipt/warranty card.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (won’t power on, won’t spin/drain, or faults present).
risks.proof: Video/clip of powering on and completing a full wash + spin cycle (including drain/spin) with no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working; treat as potentially faulty/untested.

risks.risk: Rust/oxidation and dirt stains near the lower front/door area may indicate water ingress, corrosion, or poor sealing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas plus a clip showing the door seal area during/after a wash (no leaks).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/corrosion risk; assume possible seal/leak issues.

risks.risk: Drum interior condition and cleanliness (mold/odor, damage) not visible through the door window.
risks.proof: Photo of the drum interior with the door fully opened (and ideally a quick smell/cleanliness check).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown interior condition; assume worst-case heavy grime/odor.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/hoses or incorrect parts (inlet/outlet hoses, drain hose, manual).
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out (hoses, drain hose, manual, warranty/receipt).

risks.risk: Exact model/serial not readable; could be a different variant or capacity than claimed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/serial/model label (close and readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the stated model but with uncertainty; keep at worst-case for variant mismatch.

risks.risk: Noise/vibration/balance issues during spin not shown; may require repairs.
risks.proof: Clip of the machine during spin showing stability and sound level (no excessive shaking).

proof_requests: Provide a video of the washer powering on and running a full wash cycle including spin and drain, with any error codes shown.
Send close-up photos of the rust/oxidation and the door seal area; then show the seal area during/after a wash to confirm no leaks.
Show the drum interior with the door fully opened (clear photos).
Show all included accessories laid out (inlet hose, drain hose, manual, warranty card, receipt).
Provide a clear, readable photo of the rating plate/serial/model label.
response.reason: The exterior identifies an LG DirectDrive 7kg front-load washer, but key value-determining factors (working condition, leaks, drain performance, drum condition, and accessories) are not verifiable from the photos. Rust/stains add downside risk, so proof of operation is needed before pricing confidently.
